XHelpers Pro 1.0.28 (46)
- One tap of the Dictation key inserts a result that is still waiting for a check, as you dictated it. While it waits, the floating panel shows the text and "Insert now". A fix that arrives later comes as a replacement offer. - In the Review panel, one tap does what Return does, and two quick taps still dictate more. "Hold to talk" works the same way: a press under 0.3 s counts as a tap. You can turn this off with "Tap the Dictation key to insert" in Dictation settings › Apps. - When the text has line breaks, Return and the tap now choose "Insert with line breaks". Some apps, such as terminals, take line breaks only by paste; the panel says how to turn on Paste directly for that app. - The Decisions API's answer has its own line in both panels, and the Decisions API and GPT-6 Luna each have a longer time limit you can set. GPT-6 Luna starts beside the Decisions API, so a result waits only for whichever finishes last, and a check that fails no longer stops the review. - The misheard-word check can read up to 10 KB of context: the field's text, other text from the same window, and, if you turn it on, the window read from a screenshot on this Mac. Only the words are sent. The Privacy Policy is updated. - "Use OpenAI's Fast mode" gets GPT-6 Luna's answers sooner, at twice the price per token. - The floating panel's lines show what they mean with colour and a symbol, and the panel no longer shifts as lines come and go. - Updated translations in all 25 supported languages.
